description_en: Retrieves the task information for an uploaded attachment
description_zh: 调用GetUserUploadFileJob获取上传附件的任务信息
name: GetUserUploadFileJob

parameters.help_en: The JobKey of the attachment upload task. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206059.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206060.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 上传附件任务JobKey，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206059.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206060.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: job_key

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the system. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

UploadFileJobDetail.description_en: The details of the attachment upload task

AttachmentKey.description_en: The attachment key returned after the attachment is successfully uploaded. You can use this key when creating a ticket
AttachmentKey.description_zh: 上传附件成功后返回的附件Key，可在创建工单时使用

FileSource.description_en:
The purpose of the file upload. Valid values:
datacorrect: Data change ticket.
order_info_attachment: Ticket attachment.
big-file: Batch data import.
sqlreview: SQL review
FileSource.description_zh:
文件上传的使用目的，取值与说明如下：
datacorrect：数据变更工单
order_info_attachment：工单附件
big-file：批量数据导入
sqlreview：SQL审核

JobKey.description_en: The JobKey of the attachment upload task

JobStatus.description_en:
The status of the attachment upload task. Valid values:
INIT: Initialized.
PENDING: Waiting for task fetching.
BE_SCHEDULED: Waiting to be scheduled.
FAIL: Execution failed.
SUCCESS: Execution succeeded.
RUNNING: Running
JobStatus.description_zh:
上传附件任务状态，取值和说明如下：
INIT：初始化状态
PENDING：等待任务抓取
BE_SCHEDULED：待调度
FAIL：执行失败
SUCCESS：执行成功
RUNNING：正在执行

JobStatusDesc.description_en: The description of the task status

UploadOSSParam.description_en:
The OSS information of the uploaded attachment.
This parameter is displayed when the UploadType parameter is set to OSS
UploadOSSParam.description_zh:
上传附件OSS信息。
当UploadType参数为OSS时显示

BucketName.description_en: The unique identifier of the OSS bucket

ObjectName.description_en: The name of the OSS object

UploadType.description_en:
The type of the attachment upload task. Valid values:
URL
OSS
UploadType.description_zh:
上传附件任务类型，取值：
URL
OSS

UploadURL.description_en:
The URL of the uploaded attachment.
This parameter is displayed when the UploadType parameter is set to URL
UploadURL.description_zh:
上传附件URL链接。
当UploadType参数为URL时显示

UploadedSize.description_zh: 已上传的大小，单位为字节
